title: Apple: modeled ₹1,301/qtl left, Narnaul → Solan
summary: January 2023: reported apple prices at Narnaul and Solan imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 92% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,301 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 196 same-variety market pairs screened for apple in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Solan report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Narnaul (Haryana) and Solan (Himachal Pradesh) both reported apple prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Narnaul reported a median ₹4,750 per quintal. Solan reported a median ₹6,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,000 per quintal, and Solan was dearer on 92% of days.

scenes.headline: 378 km by road
scenes.caption: 378 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~5 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹81/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,296 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹923 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Solan report, the rule selects 22 of 26 modeled shipping days. 22 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,301 per quintal (₹966 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Apple route from Narnaul to Solan was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹130,100, or ₹96,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to apple
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹81/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Apple route from Narnaul to Solan was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹130,100, or ₹96,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
